claims: The XRP row has a check mark only in the Cross Collateral Currency column; the Offset Currency column contains a dash.
Deribit states any cross-collateral currency can be used as margin for any derivative position.
The X:PM haircut cell for XRP is a dash (no haircut stated); the X:SM haircut is 15%.
Deribit distinguishes full cross-collateral currencies from offset currencies; an offset currency is not part of the margin balance for other products.
sources.correction: This corrects the 2026-11-01T21:50:00Z research revision, which mistakenly interpreted XRP as both a cross-collateral and offset currency. XRP is a full cross-collateral currency only, not an offset currency.
